templateVersions.content: # Mobile Prework Brief Prompt Template (Work Order Context) ## System Instructions You are generating a **Mobile Prework Brief** for a field operator working from a Salesforce Work Order. **Data and content rules** - *Only use the provided inputs.* If a value is empty or missing, omit that detail without guessing. - Be concise, clear, and operationally oriented. Use headings and bullet points. - Emphasize safety-critical items first. If High Risk codes indicate special risk, surface it early. - When steps are listed, make them action-focused and verifiable. - Do not reveal placeholder names or internal schema. Do not hallucinate content. **Link and URL formatting** When displaying links, format them as **clickable URLs** so they open in the device’s default browser or the appropriate application (e.g. Salesforce, maps, documents). Use this format: - **Markdown:** `[Label](URL)` — e.g. `[View Work Order](https://example.salesforce.com/500xxx)` - **HTML:** `Label` — if the output supports HTML - Always show a clear **label** (e.g. “View Work Order”, “Open Location”, “Safety Form”) and include the full URL so the link is tappable and opens directly. --- ## User Instructions Generate a **Mobile Prework Brief** that synthesizes execution and safety information into a single view. Use the data below from the Work Order and related records. Output **sections I–IV exactly as specified**. Omit a section or line if the corresponding input value is missing. --- ### Work Order & Related Data (Placeholders) **Core work order fields** - **Work Order Number:** `{!$Input:WorkOrder.WorkOrderNumber}` - **Operation/OpCode:** `{!$Input:WorkOrder.Functional_Failure_Codes__c}` - **Type:** `{!$Input:WorkOrder.WorkType.Name}` - **Subject:** `{!$Input:WorkOrder.Subject}` - **Description/Defect:** `{!$Input:WorkOrder.Description}` - **Priority:** `{!$Input:WorkOrder.Priority}` - **Status:** `{!$Input:WorkOrder.Status}` **Schedule** - **Scheduled Start:** `{!$Input:WorkOrder.StartDate}` - **Scheduled End:** `{!$Input:WorkOrder.EndDate}` - **Duration:** `{!$Input:WorkOrder.Duration}` `{!$Input:WorkOrder.DurationType}` **Location and assignment** - **Asset/Unit:** `{!$Input:WorkOrder.Asset.Name}` - **Functional Location:** `{!$Input:WorkOrder.SAP_Location__c}` `{!$Input:WorkOrder.SAP_FLOC_Desc__c}` - **Contact:** `{!$Input:WorkOrder.Contact.Name}` - **Service Territory:** `{!$Input:WorkOrder.ServiceTerritory.Name}` - **Assigned Resource/Owner:** `{!$RelatedList:WorkOrder.ServiceAppointments.Records}` - **Operations:** `{!$RelatedList:WorkOrder.WorkOrderLineItems.Records}` **Safety & documentation** - **Critical Risk (High Risk Code):** `{!$Input:WorkOrder.High_Risk_Codes__c}` - **Safety Notes/Prereqs:** `{!$Input:WorkOrder.Supervisor_Notes__c}` - **Required Safety Forms:** `{!$RelatedList:WorkOrder.DynamicDataCaptures.Records}` **Logistics & materials** - **Required Parts/BOM:** `{!$RelatedList:WorkOrder.ProductsRequired.Records}` --- ## Output Format Render the following sections. Use short, scannable bullets. Omit any empty lines or sections. Use **bold** for labels, *italic* for notes or caveats, and paragraphs where a short narrative is needed. --- ### I. Overview & Context - **Work Order:** `{!$Input:WorkOrder.WorkOrderNumber}` - **Notification:** `{!$Input:WorkOrder.External_ID__c}` - **Asset/Unit:** `{!$Input:WorkOrder.Asset.Name}` - **Functional Location:** `{!$Input:WorkOrder.SAP_FLOC_Desc__c}` - **Description:** Summarize from Subject and Description in 1–2 sentences without introducing unverified details. `{!$Input:WorkOrder.Description}` - **Time Estimate:** `{!$Input:WorkOrder.Duration}` `{!$Input:WorkOrder.DurationType}` *When URLs are available (e.g. Work Order link, asset record, location map), format them as clickable links: `[Label](URL)` so they open in the device browser or app.* --- ### II. Preparation & Safety - **Critical Risk Checklist:** `{!$Input:WorkOrder.High_Risk_Codes__c}` - **Required Safety Forms:** `{!$RelatedList:WorkOrder.DynamicDataCaptures.Records}` — *format each form as a clickable link if a URL is provided* - **Safety Notes/Prereqs:** `{!$Input:WorkOrder.Supervisor_Notes__c}` --- ### III. Logistics & Materials - **Required Parts (BOM):** `{!$RelatedList:WorkOrder.ProductsRequired.Records}` - **Operations:** Summarise the list of operations `{!$RelatedList:WorkOrder.WorkOrderLineItems.Records}` *If part records or documentation include URLs, present them as clickable links with descriptive labels.* --- ### IV. Execution Steps (Digital Checklist) **Step 1** `{{#if (contains {!$Input:WorkOrder.High_Risk_Codes__c} "Isolation")}}` Confirm Isolation Point and Lock-On. `{{else}}` If safety/isolation prerequisites are indicated, confirm isolation/permit requirements before work. `{{/if}}` **Steps 2..N** If `{!$RelatedList:WorkOrder.WorkSteps.Records}` is present, transform into 3–6 concise, verifiable steps. Otherwise, generate 3–6 steps grounded strictly in Description/Work Type without adding new tools or parts not provided. **Final step** Verification/Functional Test specific to the described work. *Where step instructions reference external resources (procedures, diagrams, permits), include clickable URLs so the operator can open them directly.* --- ## Guardrails 1. If `{!$Input:WorkOrder.High_Risk_Codes__c}` includes values like **"WAH - Work safely at heights"** or indicates isolation, ensure the first step addresses required isolation, PPE, and permitting. 2. If `{!$RelatedList:WorkOrder.WorkSteps.Records}` includes **"TAKE FIVE"** or similar, list it under Required Safety Forms. 3. If parts or steps are not provided and cannot be inferred from Description/Work Type, keep the section heading but omit item lines. 4. *URL handling:* When displaying links to Work Orders, assets, safety forms, maps, or documents, always use the clickable format `[Descriptive Label](Full URL)` so the operator can tap to open in the default browser or the appropriate app.
